name: volfpeter/uspto-patent-citation-graph
what_it_holds: Python tool (MIT, 16 stars, updated Aug 2026) that downloads patent citation data on-demand from USPTO's PatentsView API and caches it in a local SQL database (SQLite) plus in-memory graph for fast repeat queries. No data pre-committed — pulls per-query.
why_useful: Same patent-monitoring gap (#15) as above but with a caching/graph layer that would let a team build a citation-network view of Airbnb's (or a competitor's) patent portfolio without repeated API hits.
size_hint: tool only, DB built on first run
themes: Product-launch monitors: certificate transparency (crt.sh) tooling, app release-notes scrapers, Wayback diff tools, help-center change monitors, trademark/patent (USPTO, PatentsView) clients
why_all: Same patent-monitoring gap (#15) as above but with a caching/graph layer that would let a team build a citation-network view of Airbnb's (or a competitor's) patent portfolio without repeated API hits.
Marginal for ABNB specifically (citation-network analysis is more an R&D-intensity tool for hardware/tech firms); listed for completeness under the patent-client theme.
